name: pi-agentview
description: Agent View for the pi coding agent — a fleet dashboard for background sessions (Claude Code-style). Cross-platform (Windows/Linux/macOS).
author: Joshua Chang

scripts.test: node node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent/node_modules/jiti/lib/jiti-cli.mjs smoke.ts && node node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent/node_modules/jiti/lib/jiti-cli.mjs smoke-extension.ts && node node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent/node_modules/jiti/lib/jiti-cli.mjs smoke-broker.ts && npm run test:visual && npm run test:drive && npm run test:interactions
scripts.test:visual:update: node node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent/node_modules/jiti/lib/jiti-cli.mjs test/visual/stills.ts --update && node node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent/node_modules/jiti/lib/jiti-cli.mjs test/visual/drive.ts --update && node node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent/node_modules/jiti/lib/jiti-cli.mjs test/visual/interactions.ts --update
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run build:broker
